name: csgo-vulkan-fix
label: CS2 / CS:GO Vulkan Resolution Fix
description: Fixes custom stretched/black-bar 4:3 resolutions, cursor offset desync, and mode switching in Counter-Strike 2 on Wayland.

options.label: Target Game Width
options.description: Horizontal resolution in pixels expected by the game engine (e.g. 1280, 1440, 1920).

options.label: Target Game Height
options.description: Vertical resolution in pixels expected by the game engine (e.g. 960, 1080, 1440).

options.label: Game Window Class
options.description: Window class pattern to apply Vulkan resolution scaling to.

options.label: Fix Mouse Coordinate Offset
options.description: Correct cursor alignment discrepancies when playing at non-native stretched aspect ratios.
